sources.headline: DroneShield Awarded US$500M US IDIQ Procurement Vehicle
sources.dateBasis: Date printed on the announcement ('30 September 2026 ASX Announcement') and the lodgement date in the ASX PDF path
sources.verification: Fetched the ASX gate page for idsId 03145838 with curl, read the hidden pdfURL field, downloaded the two-page PDF with curl and extracted the text with the PDFKit script: title 'DroneShield Awarded US$500M US IDIQ Procurement Vehicle'; 'a three-year procurement vehicle with a ceiling value of US$500 million'; 'This IDIQ contract does not guarantee any orders and any amounts cannot be quantified at this time. DroneShield will continue to announce material orders in accordance with its disclosure policies.' The currency in the body comes from this document, not from the press release (ref-14), which states none

limits: Price figures (closes of $9.52 on 4 September, $10.34 on 18 September, $11.32 on 25 September, $11.94 on 5 October, $11.60 on 6 October, the 6.77 million-share session) and days to cover are Shorted's own end-of-day data and are stated without a citation
The squeeze score (84.4, rank first) and the 43-security divergence count (the list includes two ETF units) are Shorted-derived metrics, stated as such, not official figures

The headline pairs two windows and names both: the doubling is 1 July to 30 September (ASIC), the 25% is Shorted's one-month price change from the 4 September close to 5 October; over the doubling window itself the price rose about 15%

No motive is attributed to any short seller, lender or holder; Vanguard's and Citigroup's notices are reported as filed and their timing is placed beside the position data without a causal claim. Citigroup's Form 603 is read as filed: all four relevant-interest lines carry an obligation to return under a securities lending agreement (Annexure A names the holder of voting rights as 'Borrower') and Citibank's Sydney branch also acts as agent lender; no use of the borrowed shares is inferred
ref-10 is a live six-month ASX listing with no publication date; the sentence it supports is dated in the prose to the 7 October retrieval
The Kalkine articles (1 and 6 October) were opened but not cited; Motley Fool's broker targets and the author's opinion were not used
No prediction, no price target, no post-30 September position inferred; later ASIC reports will show any change
